title: Brand logos: assets and code verified
summary: Display bundled Puma, Adidas, Nike, New Balance, Reebok and Under Armour marks beside stock status.

changes.detail: Bundle six real brand marks from Simple Icons with SVG originals, PNG app assets and source attribution.

Match names case-insensitively and ignore spaces/hyphens for bundled marks. Preserve admin HTTPS logo overrides, fall back to bundled marks on remote failure, and keep text for unknown brands. Preserve ASICS.

validation.name: Asset visual inspection
validation.detail: Inspected a montage of all six bundled marks; all render as recognizable black brand logos with preserved proportions.

validation.name: TypeScript, focused lint and tests
validation.detail: Mobile typecheck and component ESLint passed. All eight brand registry and history tests passed.

validation.name: In-app device review
validation.detail: Actual device rendering and remote override failure interaction were not exercised. No deployment.
